$comment: Machine-readable harness catalogue. The behavioural source of truth is tools/slice-agent-runner/src/harnesses.ts; the installer's HARNESS_IDS and docs/harnesses.md mirror the same ids, and tests/test_harness_catalogue.py fails when they drift apart. Invocations were checked against vendor docs on verified_on; flags move between releases, so the vendor docs win.

harnesses.name: Claude Code
harnesses.notes: -p prints and exits. --permission-mode acceptEdits lets it write files without prompting; dontAsk is the locked-down CI variant.

harnesses.name: Codex CLI
harnesses.notes: exec runs headless; workspace-write permits edits without network. Upstream deprecated --full-auto in favour of the explicit sandbox flag.

harnesses.name: Cursor CLI
harnesses.notes: Print mode without --force only proposes changes. Some installations expose the binary as `agent`.

harnesses.name: Cline
harnesses.notes: Install with `npm i -g cline`; authenticate with `cline auth`. Headless runs trigger on redirected stdout, piped stdin or --json. --auto-approve true is what makes it unattended: use a disposable branch and constrain shell access with CLINE_COMMAND_PERMISSIONS.

harnesses.name: Aider
harnesses.notes: --no-auto-commits leaves committing to your promotion flow; --message-file avoids argv limits.

harnesses.name: Any harness (bring your own command)
harnesses.notes: Runs through a shell, so Cline, Goose, OpenHands, a custom script or a wrapper around your own tooling all plug in here.
